samples.summary: Read-only sheet mounts still write cells: cross-sheet formula recalculation bypasses the new `readOnly` gate in `YorkieStore`
samples.evidence: `sheet-view.tsx:1300` calls `runRemoteSync(true)` unconditionally right after mount (and `:1312` re-runs it on every `remote-change`), which reaches `sheet.recalculateCrossSheetFormulas()` (`packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:963` — no `_readOnly` guard, unlike every other mutator in that file) → `packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2964-2980` → `calculate()` → `packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:67/81` `sheet.setCell()/deleteCell()`, which land in `YorkieStore.setCell` (`yorkie-store.ts:~271` `this.doc.update(...)`). The new constructor gate only silences the presence seed, `updateSelection` and `ensureAxisOrder`; the document mutators are untouched, so a share-link viewer opening a sheet that contains any cross-sheet formula issues a root-mutating `doc.update()` — exactly the `rw` PushPull the diff's own comment says the auth webhook refuses, wedging the viewer's sync, and a viewer mutating shared cell data. `recomputeFilterHiddenRows` on the same path (`sheet.ts:1613/1634` `store.setFilterState`) writes too. Fix belongs either on the new gate (guard the write mutators / batch flush when `readOnly`) or at the `runRemoteSync(true)` call sites.

samples.summary: Cell comment popover renders on read-only sheet mounts and its handlers write the CRDT root without the new gate
samples.evidence: The popover is rendered with no `readOnly` condition (`sheet-view.tsx:1709-1729`) and auto-opens on selection whenever the cell has unresolved threads (`sheet-view.tsx:1166-1168`), which runs on a viewer mount too. Its handlers call store writes with no `readOnly` check: `handleCommentReply` (`:921` `store.addReply`), `handleCommentResolve` (`:940` `store.setThreadResolved`), `handleCommentEdit` (`:967` `store.editComment`), `handleCommentDelete` (`:974` `store.deleteComment`) — all `doc.update()` on the document root inside `YorkieStore`. Anonymous visitors are stopped only incidentally (`commentAuthor` null), but a signed-in user on a viewer-role share link has a `commentAuthor`, so these are reachable `rw` writes from a read-only mount, the same failure the new gate exists to prevent (and edit/delete do not even check `commentAuthor`).

samples.summary: `ensureAxisOrder` no-op on read-only mounts silently drops the viewer's selection anchors, so their selection no longer survives a peer's structural edit
samples.evidence: `packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:3029-3047`: after `ensureAxisOrder` (now a no-op for a read-only `YorkieStore`), `maxRow > rowOrder.length || maxCol > colOrder.length` clears `activeCellAnchor`/`rangeAnchors`, so `resolveAnchorsToRefs()` (called from `packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5220` on every remote sync) leaves nothing anchored. Any viewer selection beyond the currently materialised axis coverage therefore loses its anchor-based stability across a peer's row/col insert — a behaviour the new constructor comment's "Reads are untouched" does not mention. Acceptable trade-off, but the doc comment and the engine assumption are now out of step.

samples.summary: Docs pending-import apply still mutates the document on a read-only mount (currently unreachable only by accident)
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-view.tsx:392-399` calls `store.setDocument(pending)` inside the same effect that now constructs the store with `readOnly`, with no `readOnly` check. It is reachable only when `documentId` is set, and the shared/viewer route (`packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:362-368`) passes `readOnly` but no `documentId`, so today it cannot fire for a viewer. Any future caller that passes both would make a viewer replace the whole shared document; the guard belongs next to the new `readOnly` field.

verdict.reason: The claimed bypass exists exactly as described. `sheet-view.tsx:1012` builds `new YorkieStore(doc, tabId, readOnly)` and the same mount effect calls `runRemoteSync(true)` unconditionally at `:1300` (re-run on every `remote-change` at `:1312`), with no readOnly early return anywhere in that effect. That reaches `Spreadsheet.recalculateCrossSheetFormulas` (`packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:963-967`), which is the one public mutator in that file lacking the `if (!this.sheet || this._readOnly) return;` guard used at :119, :201, :222 and ~30 other sites. It calls `Sheet.recalculateCrossSheetFormulas` (`sheet.ts:2943-2980`) → `calculate()` (`calculator.ts:67, 118, 136, 141, 164` `sheet.setCell/deleteCell`) → `sheet.ts:973-989` → `YorkieStore.set` (`yorkie-store.ts:271`), `delete` (`:326`), and via `endBatch` (`:1187`), each of which calls `this.doc.update()` on the CRDT root with no `this.readOnly` check — the only readOnly gates in the store are `:109`, `:651`, `:689`. `recomputeFilterHiddenRows` adds root writes through `store.setFilterState` (`sheet.ts:1613, 1634` → `yorkie-store.ts:1035`). Reachability for actual viewers is confirmed at `shared-document.tsx:181,283` (`role === "viewer"` → `<SheetView readOnly>`). The equality skip at `calculator.ts:157-163` and the `size === 0` early return at `sheet.ts:2960` only narrow, not eliminate, the write path (spill writes at :136/:141 are unconditional; remote-change recalc is precisely when values differ). This is a guard added by the diff with a bypassing site outside the diff — in-lane for blast-radius and blocking.

finding.summary: Shared spreadsheet viewer still writes presence (and can write axis order) to the CRDT — the one read-only mount this change did not guard
finding.evidence:
This change flips the Yorkie auth webhook to enforce-by-default and, on that basis, adds `readOnly` guards to every client-side local write a share-link viewer could make: `board-view.tsx:595` (selection presence), `pdf-collab.tsx:134` (activePage presence) and `slides-view.tsx:1137` (broadcast). The spreadsheet mount was missed.

`SharedDocumentLayout` mounts `<SheetView tabId=... readOnly={readOnly} />` (packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:283), and `sheet-view.tsx:1012` constructs `new YorkieStore(doc, tabId)` unconditionally — there is no read-only store variant on this path (`ReadOnlyStore` in packages/sheets/src/store/readonly.ts is a separate class only exported, never wrapped around `YorkieStore`).

- packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:86 — the constructor itself does `this.doc.update((_, p) => p.set({ activeTabId }))`, so a viewer produces a local change the moment the sheet mounts.
- packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:628 — `updateSelection()` publishes presence on every selection change; it is called unconditionally from the model (`packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:3045` and `:3058`), with no `readOnly` gate anywhere in between.
- packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:657 — `ensureAxisOrder()`, invoked from the same selection path (`sheet.ts:3029`), is a genuine **root** write when a selection reaches past current axis coverage.

By the diff's own reasoning (see the comments it adds at board-view.tsx:595 and pdf-collab.tsx:129), a local change is carried by the next `PushPull` with verb `rw`, which the now-default-enforcing webhook refuses for a share-link `viewer` — wedging the viewer's own sync. For sheets this happens at mount, before the visitor touches anything.

verdict.reason: The finding's central factual claim — that the spreadsheet mount was missed and `YorkieStore` has no read-only gate — is not true of this tree. `YorkieStore` takes a third `readOnly` parameter (yorkie-store.ts:98-105) and gates all three writes the finding names: the mount-time presence seed is wrapped in `if (!this.readOnly)` (yorkie-store.ts:109-113), `updateSelection()` early-returns on `if (this.readOnly) return;` (yorkie-store.ts:650-651) before its presence `doc.update`, and `ensureAxisOrder()` early-returns likewise (yorkie-store.ts:688-689) before its root `doc.update`. The quoted call site is also wrong: sheet-view.tsx:1012 is `new YorkieStore(doc, tabId, readOnly)`, not the two-argument form, with `readOnly` the component prop (sheet-view.tsx:130,139) present in the effect deps (sheet-view.tsx:1341). The viewer path supplies it as true: shared-document.tsx:181 sets `readOnly = resolved.role === "viewer"` and :283 forwards it to `<SheetView>`. Because the gate sits inside the store, the unconditional model-side `updateSelection`/`ensureAxisOrder` calls from sheet.ts cannot reach a `doc.update`, so there is no bypass. The remaining two-argument constructions are test fixtures only (tests/helpers/single-user-yorkie.ts:54, tests/helpers/two-user-spreadsheet-yorkie.ts:103-104, tests/helpers/cross-sheet-yorkie.ts:101, tests/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-axis-order.test.ts:60), which are not the share-link viewer mount.
